taylor-cos-wrap.alt: The graph of y = cos x from x = -6.5 to 6.5 with three Taylor polynomials about x = 0: P sub 2 = 1 minus x squared over 2, a downward parabola that follows cos x for about |x| < 1; P sub 4, which adds x to the fourth over 24 and follows it to about |x| = 2; and P sub 6, which follows it to about |x| = 3. All three agree with cos x at x = 0 and peel away farther out.
